ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The diagram is an animal cell with labeled organelles. I can see labels such as cell membrane, cytoplasm, Golgi apparatus, mitochondrion, nucleus, ribosomes, rough ER, smooth ER, and labels pointing to small sac-like structures marked “Vacuole” / “vacuole.” Reasoning: The question asks which part contains food, water, and metabolic waste. In cells, vacuoles are storage organelles that can hold water, food materials, and waste products. Therefore, the labeled part that matches this function is the vacuole.
